cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Gracious Command
cards.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for helping me move. Would you rather pack books or plates? I'll show you the proper way for either.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Books, please. I'm nervous about breaking china.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That care is exactly what the plates need. Paper between each one, please; I'll take the books.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wrap them while you put them in boxes?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. The boxes are beside you; set the wrapped plates upright in them. I'll get the books downstairs so you have room to work. Thank you.
